title: Plasma protein profiling predicts cancer in patients with non-specific symptoms
core_idea: Use high-throughput plasma proteome profiling to identify proteins associated with cancer in patients presenting with non-specific symptoms and build a blood-test-based model to triage and prioritize patients for rapid diagnostic pathways.
tldr: Plasma protein profiling is used to develop a blood-based triage model to prioritize patients with non-specific symptoms for expedited cancer diagnostics such as PET–CT.
